crop.notes: Answers to Correspondents column; Allen appears in two one-line answers (Mace, and his 1892 picks). Bottom of the column continues beyond the crop, but both Allen items are inside it

title.suggested: Answers to Correspondents: Allen Never Fought Mace

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch's Answers to Correspondents told readers that Tom Allen never fought Jem Mace, and that Allen had picked Sullivan, McAuliffe and Dixon to win and backed all three.

metadata.notes: Masthead: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Tuesday, September 20, 1892, page 4

facts.fact: The Post-Dispatch answered a reader that Allen never fought Jem Mace (contradicts the 1870 Allen-Mace fight recorded elsewhere)
Allen picked Sullivan, McAuliffe and Dixon to win their September 1892 New Orleans fights and bet on all three

notes: Current title 'Jem Mace Defeats Tom Allen' is the opposite of what the item says. The column does not name New Orleans; the link to the Sept. 1892 Olympic Club carnival is inferred from the trio named.
